meta.title: Graphpaper — Q3 2026 board update
meta.description: Q3 2026 board update for Graphpaper, a payroll platform in 14 European countries: answer first, KPI scorecard, the late-payroll trend, the Germany win, the Poland miss, cash, Q4 plan, risks and two votes.

slides.eyebrow: Graphpaper · Q3 2026 board update · 14 October 2026 · Confidential
slides.heading: Revenue on plan. Payroll reliability slipped.
slides.lead: ARR reached €31.4M, 2% over plan. One outage made 41 payroll runs late; we ask you to fund the fix.
slides.notes: Lead with both halves. The board will ask about Poland first; tell them it is slide 7.

slides.heading: Growth beat plan, reliability missed, and two votes set up Q4
slides.body:
Won: Germany added 61,000 paid employees in its first quarter.
Won: gross margin rose to 71%.
Missed: on-time payroll fell to 99.2% after the Poland outage.
slides.aside: Decide today: fund a six-person reliability team, and approve the Netherlands launch.
slides.notes: If the board reads one slide, it is this one.

slides.heading: Three of five KPIs beat plan; reliability and support did not
One outage made September our worst month: 41 late payroll runs
slides.lead: Source: run ledger, all 14 countries, April to September 2026. A run is late when pay lands after 09:00 on payday.

slides.heading: What worked, and what did not
A DATEV connector made Germany our fastest launch yet
slides.body: German accountants already keep payroll data in DATEV. Our connector imports it in one step, so firms switch in 9 days instead of 40.
slides.aside: 38 customers and 61,000 employees in 13 weeks. Plan was 25 customers.

slides.heading: A Polish tax change overloaded our queue and paid 2,900 people late
slides.left:
New tax codes went live on 1 September.
The batch queue stalled for 19 hours.
41 runs late, €84,000 in customer credits.
slides.right:
Queue rebuilt per country, live on 30 September.
Release freeze 10 days around every tax change.
No late runs from this cause since.
slides.notes: Own it plainly. The fix shipped; the reliability team keeps it fixed.

slides.quote: Two hundred of our staff were paid a day late. We need to know January will be different.
slides.by: Finance director, Kraków logistics customer · 3,100 employees

slides.heading: Burn fell to €1.3M a month and runway reaches 33 months

stats.label: Cash at 30 September (€42.6M), down €3.9M in Q3
Monthly net burn, down from €1.6M in Q2
Runway at current burn, up from 28

slides.heading: Q4: reliability first, then the Netherlands
Q4 locks in reliability before the January tax season
January tax changes in six countries are the top risk
rows: Tax changes in 6 countries on 1 Jan
Dutch pilot firms churn after trial

slides.heading: We ask the board for two votes and one piece of advice

cards.title: Vote: €0.9M reliability team
cards.body: Six engineers for 12 months, hired by January.

cards.title: Advice: customer credits
cards.body: Should credits be automatic for any late run?

slides.notes: Take the votes in order. The credits question is advice, not a vote.

slides.heading: Fund reliability now so growth never costs us trust
slides.lead: Approve both votes today and the reliability team starts before the January tax season.
